value.text: Console pane retired. The name came from Igor's original text-console chat UI where debug messages were mixed into the interactive space. That origin no longer applies. The actual pane set is: public feed, personal feed, Status, Settings, INFO, DEBUG. Devices can override any or add more. Each device gets a circuit breaker on its settings panel; cairn's settings has breakers for everybody. INFO and DEBUG are their own panes, not a combined 'console'.
